summary: Iteration 96 tested the Jun-2026 owner batch on both backend and frontend, looking mainly for double entry, duplicates and reconciliation drift. Both main-agent suites still pass (13/13 and 15/15). My new suite test_iter96_reconciliation.py has 7 tests: 5 pass and 2 fail on real bugs. The concurrency test is flaky because it hits a race: it reproduced in 2 of 3 runs (once via /tmp/race2.py, once in pytest). Ad-hoc scripts found 3 more serious problems. (1) CRITICAL: concurrent seller settlements create several open withdrawals. 4 parallel POST /withdrawals calls gave 3 pending settlements, charged the fee 3 times, recovered the cashback 3 times (outstanding went to -200) and took 15000 from the wallet. (2) CRITICAL: double-tapping admin cashback recovery recovers twice. 3 parallel calls against 60 owed took 120 and 180 in two runs, and outstanding went negative. (3) HIGH: rejecting a settlement returns only the net payout, so the seller keeps losing the 2.56% fee (128 per 5000) on a settlement that never happens. (4) MEDIUM: completing a recharge sends the buyer a parcel-style 'Order delivered — Your parcel has been delivered' notification, and a replayed delivered PATCH sends it again. The 'Recharge successful' notification itself is not duplicated. Verified working: settlement maths, with net worth moving by exactly +fee (128) and receivables dropping by the cashback adjusted; wallet recovery (method/reference ignored, no bank_ledger row, net worth unchanged, empty wallet gives 400, amount 0 gives 400, wallet_balance and recoverable_now returned); recharge completion writes no extra money rows; local vs national recharge routing; the refund-from-company guard; DP scope enforcement (out-of-scope DTH order hidden, status PATCH gives 403, empty scope shows it); the Excel export (Recharge sheet present, 954 debit rows all have a negative Amount and a Remarks value). Frontend checks on the web preview at 390x844, using CDP touch swipes, all pass except one: on /admin/payouts the swipe changes the bottom tab to Wallet instead of switching the Pending/Processing/Success/Rejected strip. Passing: admin bottom tabs, delivery partner Delivery/Chat/Profile, the in-screen strips on Returns, Approvals, KYC, Approved, Rejected and Cashback, vendor Net worth and Returns, delivery Net worth, buyer tabs, no biometric prompt on web for any role with login not blocked, bag wallet balance 47,877 with no false 'short' warning, map-shops Normal (1) / Recharge (1) chips with kind/operator chips and save persisting, the cashback recovery sheet (wallet balance, collectable, no UPI/cash/bank/UTR options, collect clears the outstanding), the withdraw breakdown (5000 - 50 - 128 = 4822, matching the API exactly), the recharge 'Served by Test Shop' line, and SUCCESS shown in green in history. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

critical.issue: Race condition: the check for an open settlement (find_one) and the insert are not atomic, with many awaits between them. 4 parallel requests created 3 pending withdrawals, debited the fee 3 times (WDLFEE keys differ per wid), ran recover_outstanding_from_wallet 3 times (100 owed recovered 3 times, cashback_outstanding = -200) and took 15000 from vendor_earnings. Ref: routes/withdrawals.py:105-234

Double-tap race: the code reads 'owed', then debits the wallet with a RANDOM idempotency key (CBRECOVER-WALLET:{uuid}), then applies an unconditional $inc -take. 3 parallel calls against 60 owed applied 120 in one run and 180 in another; outstanding went to -60 / -120, the seller was over-debited and the admin cashback_funded bucket was over-credited. Ref: core/cashback.py:842-876

Only w.amount (the net payout) goes back to the wallet. The 2.56% transaction_fee (WDLFEE row, plus platform_fee_collected bucket and WDLFEEREV revenue row) is never reversed, so every rejected seller settlement costs the seller 128 per 5000 and inflates revenue. Reproduced: wallet 6591.5 -> 11363.5 (+4772, not 4900); platform_fee unchanged after the reject. The cashback adjustment staying recovered is acceptable. Ref: server.py:1858-1872

minor.issue: The buyer gets the generic 'Order delivered — Your parcel has been delivered. Enjoy!' notification for a mobile recharge, and a replayed delivered PATCH sends it a second time (3 notifications for complete + replay; expected only 1, 'Recharge successful'). recharges.completed_at is correctly unchanged.

Side effects happen before validation: the cashback recovery runs before the net_payout<=0 and 'left' checks. If the withdrawal_hold debit then fails (InsufficientFunds), the withdrawal doc is deleted but the fee debit, the revenue row and the platform_fee bucket credit stay, so a fee is charged with no settlement. The cashback leg should also use a wid-based key (e.g. WDLCB:{wid}).

vendor_outstanding rows of kind 'return_refund' (seller short) are inserted on every retry while status=refund_pending, with no dedupe. They are never settled anywhere: grep finds no code that closes kind return_refund or return_refund_company_funded. When the company later funds the refund, a second outstanding row (return_refund_company_funded) is added for the same return. These company-fronted refunds are also missing from master.receivables_total, which only counts users.cashback_outstanding. Ref: core/returns.py:587-667

Data note: with pincode 110001 the response is supplier 'national' with 0 plans. There is currently no 'Everyone' (all-India) recharge vendor and no admin-seeded plan, so shoppers outside 517644/517641 see no recharge plans.

ui_bugs.issue: Swiping anywhere on /admin/payouts navigates the BOTTOM tab (payouts -> wallet / more) through admin/_layout useSwipePager. The Pending/Processing/Success/Rejected useTabSwipe never fires, so the in-screen strip cannot be reached by swipe. Payouts is the only screen that is both a bottom tab and has an inner strip. Fix: let the inner strip handle the swipe and fall through to the bottom tabs only at its ends, or disable the layout swipe there.

issues: A seller who sells BOTH parcels and recharges (Test Shop) appears only under 'Recharge shops'. Mapping him there also maps all his normal parcel orders, which is not obvious to the admin.
The operator chips list mobile AND DTH operators (Tata Play, Dish TV, d2h…) even when only 'Mobile recharge' is ticked.
'Add ₹99,900 more to your bag to get free delivery' on a ₹100 bag; the free-delivery threshold looks misconfigured (₹1,00,000).
The wallet balance value in the footer has no testID.
The body text has a hard {"\n"} line break in the middle of the sentence ('you can open\nyour account'). Ref: src/biometric-enroll-prompt.tsx:75

action_items: CRITICAL: Make POST /withdrawals atomic per user. Take a lock before any money moves (e.g. users.update_one({id, settlement_lock:{$ne:true}}, {$set:{settlement_lock:true}}) and release it in finally), or add a partial unique index on withdrawals.user_id where status is open. Key the cashback leg as WDLCB:{wid}.

CRITICAL: In recover_outstanding_from_wallet, decrement cashback_outstanding conditionally (find_one_and_update {id, cashback_outstanding:{$gte:take}}) BEFORE the wallet debit, or serialise with a per-vendor lock, so a double tap can never recover twice or drive outstanding below 0.

HIGH: When a seller settlement is rejected (and on any failed payout path), reverse the transaction_fee too: credit the vendor wallet with WDLFEE_REJECT:{wid}, post a revenue reversal and decrement platform_fee_collected. Alternatively take the fee only when the settlement is approved/paid. Show the fee refund in the rejection notification.
MEDIUM: Skip the parcel 'Order delivered' notification for order_kind == 'recharge', and make the delivered-branch notifications idempotent on replay.
MEDIUM: On /admin/payouts, fix the swipe conflict between the admin _layout bottom-tab pager and the in-screen useTabSwipe.

MEDIUM: Dedupe and settle vendor_outstanding kind 'return_refund' / 'return_refund_company_funded'. Add recovery for company-funded refunds, and include them in receivables_total so net worth stays traceable.
LOW: Seed or configure an all-India ('Everyone') recharge supplier, or admin plans, so shoppers outside the local seller's zone get plans.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/withdrawals.py: there are side effects (cashback recovery, fee debit, revenue row) before every validation has run and before the hold. If the hold fails, the fee stays charged with no withdrawal doc.
core/cashback.py:857: the idempotency key uses uuid4 per call, so it provides no protection against a replay or double tap.
routes/delivery_partner.py:532: open_count in /delivery-partner/me/vendors is not scope-filtered, so a rider scoped to Airtel-only still sees the seller's full open-order count.
server.py is 10.5k lines and should be split further.

success_rate.backend: 5/7 pytest pass (the 2 failures are real bugs); concurrency race reproduced in 2 of 3 runs; main agent suites 28/28 pass
success_rate.frontend: about 92% (12 of 13 items pass; Payouts in-screen swipe fails)

seed_data_creation: Temporary vendor_outstanding rows prefixed TEST_iter96_ (deleted afterwards). Several 5000 settlements by testvendor were created and then rejected; each one permanently cost him 128 because of the fee bug. The race tests over-recovered cashback from testvendor (extra cashback_recovery debit rows of 60, 60, 120 and the 3-way settlement race); these stay in the ledger as evidence. The admin cashback_funded bucket and platform_fee were therefore over-credited by the test runs. 2 paid recharges (account 9876509999) were completed to success. The rider_test DP mapping for Test Shop now has an EMPTY recharge scope (previously mobile/airtel). The buyer cart was emptied again.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use CDP touch events for swipe tests: Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled, then Input.dispatchTouchEvent with touchStart, 10 touchMoves of dx 220 and touchEnd. Playwright mouse drags only select text. On every run, test_iter96_reconciliation.py makes and rejects a 5000 settlement for testvendor, which costs 128 until the fee-refund bug is fixed; the vendor needs at least 5200 in vendor_earnings. The Mongo DB is referral_ecom_db on localhost. GET /admin/cashback/outstanding returns {vendors:[{vendor_id, outstanding, wallet_balance, recoverable_now}], rows, total}.
rca_of_issue: Settlement / recovery duplication: both handlers follow read -> await (many) -> write with no atomic guard, and the per-call idempotency keys are random (wid or uuid). Concurrent requests therefore each pass the 'no open settlement' or 'owed' check and each write their own rows. Reproduce: 4 threads POST /api/withdrawals {amount:5000} at the same time with cashback_outstanding=100 seeded, giving 3 x 200 and 3 pending withdrawals. 3 threads POST /admin/cashback/outstanding/{vid}/recover {amount:60} with 60 owed give 120-180 applied. Mitigation: a conditional atomic update or lock as the first write, before any debit. Fee kept on reject: admin_reject_withdrawal credits only w['amount'] (the net payout), and the fee rows have no reversal.
